stance_basis: letter states no reason to believe project will have adverse environmental impact on low income neighborhoods
summary: Phillip Sanchez, Director of the Office of Economic Opportunity, delegated a response to his office's review of the draft environmental statement. The response, written on his behalf, indicates that after coordinating with their Regional Office and affected community action agencies, the OEO found no reason to believe the proposed action would adversely impact low-income neighborhoods involved.
complaint_summary: The Office of Economic Opportunity, responding on behalf of Director Phillip Sanchez, states that after reviewing the draft environmental statement in coordination with their Regional Office and affected community action agencies, they have no reason to believe the proposed action will have an adverse environmental impact on the low-income neighborhoods involved.

statement.text:
Phillip Sanchez, the Director of the Office of Economic Opportunity, has asked me to respond to your letter of April 14, 1972 regarding the draft environmental statement on the above mentioned project.
This office in coordination with our Regional Office, and the affected community action agencies have carefully reviewed this statement. On the basis of information from this review, we have no reason to believe that the proposed action will have an adverse environmental impact on the low income neighborhoods involved. Should we receive any further information we will advise.
We appreciate the opportunity to comment on this draft statement.
